headline: Turn Borrowing Demand Into An Operating System.
subheadline: Evaluate your commercial debt advisory workflows across 8 operational stages. Generate an executive blueprint with prioritized automation leaks and a 30-day implementation roadmap.

thesis.title: The Operator Thesis
thesis.subtitle: Why modern commercial deal desks scale on systems, not headcount
thesis.quote: Brokers celebrate lead volume; operators build conversion pipelines. When underwriting packets are assembled with verified financial criteria, lender turnaround drops from 18 days to 48 hours.
